title: 1745 planning data
body: Fixes #1745 creates some types and early test data, ready for developing Planning Channel

issues.title: B. Create data types for Planning Channel
issues.body:
Create early data-types necessary for the Planning Channel.

To include:
- new type for channel and participants `CHANNEL_PLANNING, PARTICIPANT_PLANNING, ChannelPlanning, ParticipantPlanning`
- new `MessagePlanning` (to include optional start and end dates)
- some participants to include templates
- some participants to include response template
- don't let Admin tab fall over with channel-not-recognised
- new `ChannelPlanning` component as extension of `ChatChannel` (dumb placeholder)
- changes to `factory.tsx` to display new `ChannelPlanning` component

Also create a new `wargame` that contains the above data.  Hmm, maybe plus a TS data object that produces suitable messages.
